widgets_values:
## ErosMax H3 - Simple two-pass workflow

### Generate a video
1. Select your H3 Turbo checkpoint, text encoder and video/audio VAEs. The model column retains the full workflow's loaders and model settings. Leave the Turbo LoRA bypassed when Turbo is already included in the checkpoint.
2. Write the subject, scene, action, camera and desired sound/dialogue in **Prompt**.
3. Enable **Starting image**, then choose the image that should open the video. This is a starting frame, not a reference-only input: it anchors frame **0** in both sampling passes. Bypass the loader for text-to-video; both starting-frame guides follow automatically. The same image remains available to the prompt as `<Picture 1>`.
4. Choose the first-pass resolution, final target megapixels and duration, then run.

### Starting-frame guidance
The two visible starting-frame guides use the original image at each pass's actual resolution. They follow the upper image loader automatically; leave the relay/repeater and guide nodes alone. This strengthens the opening-frame conditioning but does not guarantee an exact pixel copy. Guides centre-crop to the selected aspect ratio, so use a matching image aspect ratio to preserve the composition.

### Preview and full generation
**Preview ON** saves the first pass without the learned latent upscale or refinement. **Preview OFF** runs both stages. RTX super-resolution is applied to either result.

Use a fixed seed and keep the prompt, reference, duration and first-pass settings unchanged to allow ComfyUI to reuse the first pass when switching from Preview to Full. Seed **-1** requests a new random seed, so it does not provide that reuse.

### Sampling and resolution
Defaults are inherited from v3b: **ER-SDE**, **8 first-pass steps / sgm_uniform**, then the learned latent upscale and **3 refinement steps / beta / denoise 0.4**. The same sampler selector serves both passes.

**Selector First LowRes Pass** sets aspect ratio and initial pixel area. Keep the dimension multiple at **32**. **Final Target Megapixels** sets the second-pass size before the additional RTX upscale. Larger resolutions, longer videos and more steps require more processing and memory.

### Audio and saving
The soundtrack always comes from the **first pass**, including in Full mode. There is no audio-selection control.

Generation and saving are fixed at **24 FPS**. H3 rounds duration to supported frame counts. Set the Full and Preview filename prefixes in the output column; files are saved below ComfyUI's output folder.

**Output grain strength** keeps the existing grain treatment during batched encoding; **0 disables grain**. **Output saving quality** selects the H.264 encoder preset; the current selection is **medium**, at CRF **18**. Slower presets trade more encoding time for compression efficiency.

This independent companion workflow has one optional starting image, two-stage generation and RTX super-resolution. It has no continuation, additional-reference panel, RefMods, frame interpolation or video stitching. The complete workflow remains available separately.
